title: Generated and Pseudo Content guided Prototype Refinement for Few-shot Point Cloud Segmentation

layout.note: Three dashed rounded panels side by side, each titled with a letter; one horizontal prototype line crosses all three; prediction and ground-truth thumbnails sit outside at the right edge, the legend box under panel (a).

lesson: Draw the object being refined as one recurring glyph (here a capsule of ring, square, triangle) and redraw it after every stage; attach distillation or loss links to those copies with a distinct arrow colour, so the stage effects and the regularisers can be read at once.
